rules.description: Child must be age 4-5 for Reception entry
rules.reason_if_failed: Your child must be at least 4 years old by 31 August of the school year to apply for Reception

rules.description: Child must be age 11-12 for Year 7 entry
rules.reason_if_failed: Your child must be at least 11 years old by 31 August of the school year to apply for Year 7

rules.description: Applicant must have parental responsibility for the child
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have parental responsibility to apply for a school place. Contact your local authority for advice.

rules.description: Child must be UK resident or have right to remain
rules.reason_if_failed: Your child must be a UK resident or have right to remain to apply for a state school place

rules.description: Must apply through the local authority where the child lives
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide the child's home address to determine which local authority to apply through

rules.description: Primary applications must be submitted by 15 January
rules.reason_if_failed: The deadline for primary Reception applications was 15 January. You can still apply but your application will be considered late.

rules.description: Secondary applications must be submitted by 31 October
rules.reason_if_failed: The deadline for secondary Year 7 applications was 31 October. You can still apply but your application will be considered late.

edge_cases.description: Child has special educational needs requiring an Education, Health and Care (EHC) plan
edge_cases.action: Route to SEND team. School place will be named in EHC plan through separate process.

edge_cases.description: Child is in care or previously in care (highest admission priority)
edge_cases.action: Flag as priority case. Local authority will coordinate with virtual school head.

edge_cases.description: Exceptional medical or social reasons for specific school placement
edge_cases.action: Route to admissions panel. Supporting evidence from medical/social professional required.

edge_cases.description: Family is moving house during application period
edge_cases.action: Accept proof of new address (exchange of contracts, tenancy agreement). Preferences may need updating.

edge_cases.description: Parent requesting delayed or accelerated entry (summer born, gifted, etc.)
edge_cases.action: Route to admissions panel. Decision made case-by-case with headteacher consultation.

edge_cases.description: Twins/triplets applying where only one place available at preferred school
edge_cases.action: Local authority will apply multiple birth tie-breaker policy if necessary.
